title: Testimonial · avatar + quote
description: Directly under a hero or a product claim to add a human voice. Max one per email.
usage: Single named patient quote with circular portrait. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: Transparent PNG, circle-masked portrait (lavender backdrop), contain.
Same portrait at 64px, shown on mobile via dis-block.

notes: Portrait and quote stay side by side on mobile, as in the Mobile frame; the portrait shrinks 100 → 64px by swapping images (h on the desktop one, dis-block on the mobile one, hidden inline with display:none; mso-hide:all). Replace both when swapping the portrait.
The portrait PNG carries its own circular mask, so it stays round in Outlook.
Mobile: side padding 48 → 32 (mobPad32, exact); top 32 → 20 (himobtop) and bottom 32 → 30 (mob-pad-bot), Figma 24; portrait-to-quote gutter 24 → 20 (bw20 spacer cell; Figma 16).
